targets.note: Visual mode: header (undo, redo, Visual|HTML|Plain text, Focus, Test send, Ask), subject and preview text with counts, block rail, the Northwind check-in card, the Style pane. The prototype side is its campaign email editor.
HTML mode: the compiled email as editable source in the mono face.
Plain text mode: the plain-text part as an editable page.
Focus mode: header, envelope, rail and pane slide away; only the card and the leave hint stay.
The Ask pane with three suggested changes, each accepted on its own.
The Preview pane: desktop, mobile and dark frames, merge fields filled from a record.
The Checks pane: subject, preview text, plain part and unsubscribe, each with a level dot.
